description: The agent must: (1) Read the messy transcript from workspace/meetings/q3_planning/transcript.txt among many distractor files. (2) Produce meeting_summary.md using the exact SKILL.md Meeting Summary template — including the '## Meeting Summary: [Topic]' header, **Date:** / **Type:** metadata fields, and the four emoji-prefixed sections: '### 🎯 Key Outcomes', '### 📌 Topics Discussed', '### ❓ Open Questions' (capturing the Postgres upgrade as unresolved), and '### 👥 Participants'. (3) Embed a '### ✅ Action Items' section with the exact 5-column table (Priority | Task | Owner | Deadline | Status), using the proprietary priority trigger-word mapping: Marcus's auth fix ('today', 'blocking') → 🔴 HIGH; Aisha's notifications backend ('this week') → 🟡 MEDIUM; Leo's Figma share ('this week') → 🟡 MEDIUM; Marcus's Postgres analysis and onboarding review ('this week'/'soon') → 🟡 MEDIUM; Dev's mobile bug tickets ('eventually') → 🟢 LOW. All Status cells must be '⏳ Pending', and owners must use @name format. (4) Produce followup_email.md using the exact email template: Subject line must start with '📋' and use an em dash (—) not a hyphen, opening with 'Hi [Team/Name]', three emoji-headed sections (### 🎯 Key Decisions, ### 📌 Action Items with a 3-column Task/Owner/Due table, ### 🗓 Next Steps capturing the July 15th follow-up), and closing with the exact phrase 'Questions? Reply or swing by my desk.' Traps: wrong emoji headers, missing em dash in subject, wrong priority assignments (especially confusing 'blocking/today' with MEDIUM, or 'eventually' with HIGH), missing ⏳ Pending status column, missing @ prefix on owners, and wrong/missing closing phrase.
